user.title: Heat Zones
user.description: Heat Zones drives your thermostats by the temperature in the rooms, with a weekly schedule. Areas with a thermostat: {areas}.

data.create_zones: Create a zone for every area with a thermostat

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Helps the thermal model; without it the weather entity is used.
data_description.weather: Optional. Its hourly forecast helps preheating. Empty: the best weather entity is chosen.
data_description.create_zones: Zones can be added, joined and changed later under the integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Heat Zones is already set up. Add zones under the integration.

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Helps the thermal model; without it the weather entity is used.
data_description.weather: Optional. Its hourly forecast helps preheating. Empty: the best weather entity is chosen.
data_description.heating_start: Optional. The day the heating season started: cooling of the rooms is learned from the nights before it (long-term statistics), so preheating is accurate from the first day.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: A zone is one or more rooms without doors between them, heated by one or more thermostats.

data.name: Name
data.window_pause: Pause heating while a window is open

data_description.areas: Home Assistant areas of the zone.
data_description.thermostats: Empty: every thermostat in the rooms.
data_description.windows: Empty: every window and door sensor in the rooms.

room.title: {room} ({number}/{count})
room.description: The temperature sensor of {room} and an optional limit: the zone never heats this room above it.

data_description.sensor: Empty: the area's temperature sensor, or one found in the room.
data_description.limit: For example a living room that should not get warmer than 23.5 °C while the zone measures in the hall.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Temperatures of the presets. Own presets, one per line, e.g. `Shower: 24`.

control.title: Control
control.description: How the thermostats are driven. The defaults suit most homes.

data_description.control_mode: Automatic: the room temperature goes to thermostats with a room sensor input (e.g. SONOFF TRVZB); other thermostats get a corrected target.
data_description.offset_max: For thermostats without a room sensor input: the target is corrected by the difference between their thermometer and the room, at most this much.
data_description.optimum_start: Heating for a warmer block starts early enough to reach it on time, from the learned thermal model.
data_description.external_inputs: Only when not found automatically: the number entities that take the room temperature.
data_description.sensor_selects: Only when not found automatically: the select entities that choose the thermostat's sensor.
data_description.valve_limits: Only when not found automatically: the number entities that limit the valve opening.

error.no_areas: Choose at least one room, or thermostats placed in rooms.
error.no_thermostats: There is no thermostat in these rooms. Choose thermostats.
error.invalid_presets: Write one preset per line: a name, a colon and a temperature from 5 to 30 °C. Names must differ from the standard presets and from each other.

options.room_sensor: Room temperature to the thermostat's sensor input

no_target.message: Choose at least one Heat Zones thermostat.

not_a_zone.message: {entity_id} is not a Heat Zones thermostat.

preset_or_temperature.message: Give either a preset or a temperature.

until_or_permanent.message: Give either an end time or permanent, not both.

invalid_period.message: The end must be in the future and after the start.

period_too_long.message: An override may last at most {days} days.

id_or_source.message: Give either an override ID or a source.

schedule_invalid_schedule.message: The schedule must be a list of blocks ({detail}).

schedule_too_many_blocks.message: Too many blocks in the schedule ({detail}).

schedule_invalid_days.message: Days are mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat and sun ({detail}).

schedule_invalid_time.message: A time is written as HH:MM ({detail}).

schedule_preset_or_temperature.message: Every block needs either a preset or a temperature ({detail}).

schedule_invalid_temperature.message: Temperatures in the schedule are from 5 to 30 °C ({detail}).

schedule_duplicate_block.message: Two blocks start at the same time ({detail}).

add_override.name: Add override
add_override.description: Holds a preset or a temperature from a start to an end, above the schedule. It disappears by itself.

end.name: End
end.description: When the schedule takes over again.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: A preset of the zone, e.g. away. Either a preset or a temperature.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Either a preset or a temperature.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown in the plan and on the card.

source.name: Source
source.description: Who added it, e.g. homeai; all overrides of a source can be removed at once.

override_id.name: Override ID
override_id.description: An override with the same ID is replaced. Default: a new ID.

open_end.name: Open end
open_end.description: The end is only a horizon: the sender renews or removes the override while its reason lasts (nobody home, vacation mode). No preheat towards it; a renewal keeps the override's age.

remove_override.name: Remove override
remove_override.description: Removes an override by its ID, or all overrides from a source. Without a target: in every zone.

override_id.name: Override ID
override_id.description: The ID returned by add override.

source.name: Source
source.description: Removes every override from this source.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedule and the overrides of the zones. Without a target: every zone.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the weekly schedule of the zones.

weekly.name: Weekly schedule
weekly.description: Blocks with days, a time and a preset_mode or a temperature; a block lasts until the next one, across days.

estimate.name: Estimate
estimate.description: How many minutes the zone needs to reach a temperature, and how sure the model is.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forgets room differences, heating rate and the thermal model of the zones.

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: Holds a target until the next change, until a time or permanently (until resumed).

permanent.name: Permanent
permanent.description: Hold until resumed; the schedule is paused.

resume.name: Resume schedule
resume.description: Ends a manual hold — the zone follows the schedule and overrides again.
